_comment: Several ordinary, healthy plans modeled on this repo's existing adherence_gate/wiring_repair_corpus fixture families (a goal-only task with no checklist, a small fully-covered checklist, an intentionally-phased partial rollout, and a near-complete checklist) -- used to measure the false-positive rate of a proposed coverage-ratio floor (N34) BEFORE any such floor is implemented. See test_coverage_ratio_floor_regression.py.

no_required_items._comment: The dominant real-world case (Check-3 corpus: required_items empty/absent on ~all 21 sampled runs) -- an ordinary goal-only task with no enumerable checklist at all. A ratio floor keyed on len(required_items)==0 must never fire here, or it regresses the exact false-positive class the deleted check_required_items_coverage was retired for.
no_required_items.task: Add a /volumes endpoint to the storage service with tests and docs.

full_coverage._comment: A small enumerable checklist the plan addresses completely.

phased_rollout._comment: A LEGITIMATE, healthy plan that intentionally covers a minority of an enumerated list: the task itself scopes the run to phase 1 of a 10-item backlog, deferring the rest to follow-up work explicitly named in the task. required_items still enumerates all 10 (they are real, structured items from the source doc) but only 3 are in scope for this run -- a naive ratio floor cannot distinguish this from the N34 incident's under-planning without also reading the scoping prose, which is exactly the prose-parsing this predicate is forbidden from doing. This is the false-positive case this fixture exists to demonstrate.
phased_rollout.task: ROADMAP.md lists 10 follow-up items from the Q2 retro. Phase 1 of 3: implement only items 1-3 this run; items 4-10 are tracked as separate follow-up tickets and explicitly out of scope for this task.

high_partial_coverage._comment: An ordinary healthy plan that covers most but not literally all of a small checklist (one item deferred to a documented follow-up subtask note, not silently dropped).
high_partial_coverage.task: Address the 6 items in RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md before cutting v2.0.
